persistenceOwner: world trap state; downstream effects remain owned by their target subsystems

ownershipBoundaries.combatAndSpells: resolve damage, saving throws, status effects, teleportation, and summons
ownershipBoundaries.traps: detection, visibility, disarming, triggering, charges, rearming, reset, and routing

safeFallbacks: unknown trap IDs do not trigger
corrupt persisted state falls back to validated catalog defaults
unproven chance formulas are exposed as evidence-only threshold checks
nativeDependencies: exact trap record families and field encodings
exact charge, reset, and rearm semantics
exact integration ordering with doors, containers, movement, combat, spells, quests, and NPC alerts
